All welds require complete fusion, no slag inclusion and minimum melt through. Root concavity, including centerline shrinkage, shall not exceed 1/32" for welds in pipe less than 2" nominal size or 1/16" for welds in pipe 2" or larger. Uses weldable inserts and backing rings that must be completely melted and fused to base metal on both sides.

Slag indications must conform to radiographic standards, for example a 6" length of weld 1" thick can have no indications greater than 1⁄2". When welding piping of less than a 2" diameter, radiographic indications of root undercutting may not exceed 0.016 inches or 1/64". Additionally, may be qualified in trades of brazing and silver soldering.

As a Welder (Title 32), WG-3703-10, you will perform the below duties: Performs welding duties using electric, acetylene, and/or inert gas shielded welding processes, pre-heating, brazing, head welding, tack welding, flame cutting, pressure welding, and heat treating.
